summary.text: Lee Gilreath is a Republican state representative from Anderson who has represented South Carolina House District 7 since November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Gilreath is a business owner and serves on the House Education and Public Works Committee.

paragraphs.text: Gilreath is a graduate of Clemson University, where he earned a B.S. in 1992, and served in the Army National Guard from 1987 to 1995.
Since 1996 he has been president of Earth Materials Grading, Inc.
He took office on November 11, 2024, succeeding Jay West.
The Republican primary for District 7 on June 9, 2026, was canceled, and Gilreath faces Democrat Elizabeth Cooley in the November 3 general election.
